mapper.select: SELECT v.VolumeId, v.StoryId, v.VolumeNo, v.Title, v.CreatedAt, COUNT(c.ChapterId) AS ChapterCount FROM dbo.Volume v LEFT JOIN dbo.Chapter c ON c.VolumeId = v.VolumeId AND c.IsDeleted = 0 WHERE v.StoryId = #{storyId} GROUP BY v.VolumeId, v.StoryId, v.VolumeNo, v.Title, v.CreatedAt ORDER BY v.VolumeNo

SELECT v.VolumeId, v.StoryId, v.VolumeNo, v.Title, v.CreatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Chapter c WHERE c.VolumeId = v.VolumeId AND c.IsDeleted = 0) AS ChapterCount FROM dbo.Volume v JOIN dbo.Story s ON s.StoryId = v.StoryId WHERE v.VolumeId = #{volumeId} AND s.AuthorId = #{authorId} AND s.IsDeleted = 0
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Volume WHERE VolumeId = #{volumeId} AND StoryId = #{storyId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
